title: Bodycam Footage Of Police Fatally Shooting Man With His Own Gun
description:
** (Disclaimer: Video posted strictly for educational and information purposes only) **
Body camera footage released by Roy City Police shows a deadly exchange between two Roy City police officers and a trespassing suspect at a gas station in February. One of the two officers shot the suspect, Nicholas Sanchez, 39, with Sanchez’s own weapon that the officer seized during a scuffle.
